official.application_cycle: 2026 call: opened 13 July 2026, deadline 31 October 2026, notification of decision mid-February 2027
official.status_note: The official page states 'Applications for the ERS VISIT Grant are open' with a call opening of 13 July 2026 and an application deadline of 31 October 2026.
benefits: Funding for a visit of up to one month at an institution outside the applicant's home country
Programme aim: establishing a professional relationship, network or collaboration, gaining insights and strengthening clinical and research-related competencies
eligibility: Mid-career investigators, clinicians and allied healthcare professionals transitioning to more established stages of their careers
Qualification profile for the portfolio is PhD, MD(Resp) or equivalent
The visit must take place at an institute in Europe or abroad, other than the applicant's own country
Not for clinical training and not for research projects - those activities are covered by the ERS fellowship programmes instead
The applicant is solely responsible for identifying a suitable host institution and supervisor
requirements: Agreement of the host institution, evidenced by the Host Institution Invitation Form
Support from the home supervisor, evidenced by the Home Supervisor Support Form
Application prepared in accordance with the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026
The host institution and supervisor are arranged by the applicant
documents: VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026 (published by ERS on Box)
selection_criteria: The programme funds professional visits of up to one month that establish a relationship, network or collaboration and strengthen clinical and research competencies
Applicants must demonstrate the visit fits the mid-career stage of their career
coverage: Funding for a visit of up to one month at a host institution outside the applicant's home country
application_method: Download the ERS VISIT Application Form 2026 from the official page
Secure the host institution's agreement (Host Institution Invitation Form) and home supervisor's support (Home Supervisor Support Form)
Prepare and submit the application in line with the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026
official.application_route: Download the official application form, secure host-institution and home-supervisor sign-off, and submit per the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026 before 31 October 2026.
official.study_mode: Visit of up to one month (full-time during the visit)
official.international_eligibility: Open internationally: the host institute may be in Europe or abroad, provided it is not in the applicant's own country.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Respiratory medicine and related fields; the grant is explicitly not for clinical training or research projects, which belong to the ERS fellowship programmes.
official.research_requirement: None - the grant funds a professional visit, networking and knowledge exchange, not a research project or clinical training.
official.description: The ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant offers mid-career investigators, clinicians and allied healthcare professionals who are transitioning to more established stages of their careers the chance to visit an institution outside their home country for up to one month, in order to establish a professional relationship, network or collaboration and to gain insights, strengthen competencies and knowledge that help improve clinical and research-related competencies.
official.program_type: Professional association international visit and networking grant

applicant_utility.summary: This is a short mobility grant for mid-career respiratory professionals, not a fellowship: the visit lasts up to one month, the purpose is to build an international professional relationship or collaboration, and ERS states plainly that identifying the host institution and supervisor is entirely the applicant's job. Because the application needs both a host invitation form and a home supervisor support form, the real deadline for you is several weeks before 31 October 2026 - that is when your chosen host must have agreed in writing. ERS also warns that clinical training and research projects are out of scope, so frame the visit as knowledge exchange and network building, not as a research stay.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career respiratory clinicians, investigators and allied health professionals with a PhD or MD(Resp) who can independently secure a host supervisor abroad for a one-month visit.
application_readiness_checklist: Shortlist two or three potential host institutions outside your own country and contact group leaders early - ERS puts the entire burden of finding a host on you
Obtain the signed Host Institution Invitation Form from the host and the Home Supervisor Support Form from your current supervisor before drafting
Download the current ERS VISIT Application Form 2026 and read the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026 before writing
Frame the visit around concrete outcomes: the techniques, network or collaboration you will bring back to your home institution
Submit well before the 31 October 2026 deadline, since decisions are only communicated in mid-February 2027
common_rejection_risks: Proposing clinical training or a research project - ERS explicitly excludes both from this grant
Choosing a host institution inside your own country, which breaches the mobility rule
A vague visit description with no host commitment, given that the host invitation form is mandatory
Applying at a career stage too early or too late for the mid-career profile the grant targets
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The official pages do not state what the grant covers or its value, so assume you must fund some or all of your own travel, accommodation and subsistence until the award letter states otherwise; plan a contingency budget for the month abroad.
document_audit: The host commitment must be evidenced on ERS's own Host Institution Invitation Form - a personal email invitation is not a substitute
Your home supervisor must sign the Home Supervisor Support Form, so agree the plan with them before approaching the host
Use only the 2026 application form and guidance for the current cycle; older forms may not be accepted
alerts: Decisions arrive in mid-February 2027 - months after the 31 October 2026 deadline - so do not commit to irreversible host arrangements before then
The guidance document lives on a Box link that may be hard to open on some networks; download it early rather than on deadline day
This is not a fellowship and not renewable training: if your aim is a funded research stay, apply to the ERS Short-Term or Long-Term Research Fellowships instead
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Identify and secure a host institution and supervisor yourself, complete the official application form with the host invitation and home supervisor forms, and submit per the published guidance before 31 October 2026; ERS notifies decisions in mid-February 2027.
